import numpy as np
# dead-reckoning drift: 2% distance + heading drift 2 deg/m turning -> lateral error approx
dist=np.array([10,20,40,60]) # m travelled
drift_frac=0.02
along=dist*drift_frac
# heading error accumulated 1 deg per 10 m -> lateral ~ dist*sin
heading_rate=np.deg2rad(0.1) # rad per m
lat=dist*np.sin(heading_rate*dist/2)
for d,a,l in zip(dist,along,lat):
    print(f"dist={d} m along-drift={a:.2f} m lateral~{l:.2f} m")
# with periodic camera fiducial fix every 5 m resetting to 0.05 m
print("with 5m fiducial reset: bounded error ~0.10-0.15 m")
